## Change

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior, and affected contracts or interfaces.

## Validation

Record commands and results. Include a regression for a security or economic
behavior change and explain any checks that could not run.

## Review notes

Describe effects on authorization, liabilities, rounding, bounded work, storage,
commitment encoding, and deployment compatibility where relevant. Update the
architecture and known limitations when behavior changes.

For documentation changes, verify current ABI/storage names against source and
keep implemented scope separate from planned SDK/dApp/services. Measured counts,
coverage, and resource figures must cite completed local evidence; distinguish
hosted CI/deployment and external audits from internal review. Link affected
README, API, operations, and review sections where useful.
